Si presenta solido, burroso, tuttavia a temperature di oltre i 25°C diventa liquido.  - 3   DESCRIZIONE .   3 00  Organic coconut oil is extracted from the pulp of the coconut, the fruit of a palm grown in tropical areas, especially in Asia and America.
